text: 啊……你回来啦。我才没有一直等你呢。嗯……再陪我一会儿，好不好？
style: A soft, youthful feminine voice. Shy, gentle and a little hesitant, with light breathiness, delicate clear articulation and a quiet intimate conversational delivery. Warm and slightly playful, medium-high pitch without squeaking. Natural subtle pauses. Never loud, theatrical, mature or announcer-like.
